page.overview:
What is Erlik Khan?

Erlik Khan is a fictional entity in the Marvel Universe, who first appeared in 1987 in issue #6 of the Strange Tales Vol 2 comic book series.

Erlik Khan is either a Great Old One or a Lesser Old One, who has five arms on each side, of which four pairs are of much smaller than the main pair. He is able to animate the dead, can cross dimensional barriers, and is able to teleport.

He was one of the agents of Shuma Gorath, the lord of the Great Old Ones.

Sometime in the past, the Ancient One was able to imprison him. During the late 20th century, upon the weakening of the mystical barriers protecting Earth, he sent his servants known the Khats to Earth, who then confronted Dr. Strange and his servant Wong.
